VERIFY gone from SEC-02 (d486da5), SEC-03 (a552e26), TEN-01 (a1354c3), GR example (7784dcc); no other spec lines changed (diff 6b3fe48..0130d78 on docs/specs touches only those 4 lines). go_no_go_check: Preliminary GO is not supported as worded: roadmap condition 4 (unified_pdp) not_run, condition 3 only cross-team. Evidence supports 'no NO-GO trigger found; 1 and 2 confirmed' (finding 7).

findings.problem: plugins.yaml plugin_settings.fail_on_plugin_error is ignored by cpex in v1.1.1 (read only from env PLUGINS_FAIL_ON_PLUGIN_ERROR, default false). Live: missing key file -> 'Skipping plugin GxgIdentity because fail_on_plugin_error is disabled', ContextForge healthy, tool calls reach the connector without X-GxG-Identity. The ADR states the opposite.
findings.required_improvement: Set PLUGINS_FAIL_ON_PLUGIN_ERROR=true in compose.variant-c.yaml, drop plugin_settings from the generated YAML, correct ADR line 106 and SEC-03 (env var named; with plugins off only the connector guards), add a run_spike.sh stage: missing key -> ContextForge never healthy.

findings.problem: JWS binds only arguments (ahs), not the tool name/method: a captured JWS with the same args verifies for any tool on that connector (probe). jti cache is per process: replica B accepts a replay that replica A rejected (probe). SEC-03 lists neither tool binding nor a shared jti store, so M1 can comply and keep both gaps.
findings.required_improvement: Add a signed tool claim (the name sent upstream; check the alias path) or hash {name, arguments}; verifier compares it. In SEC-03 add 'tool name signed and checked' and 'jti store shared by all replicas of a connector, retained until exp+skew'; name the canonical JSON form.

findings.problem: Mutation self-check covers signature, exp, ahs, jti only. Removing the aud check makes a t-alpha JWS accepted by the t-beta connector and no spike step fails (probe); same for exp-iat<=60, iss, kid, sub-in-tenant. aud is the only guard against cross-connector reuse.
findings.required_improvement: Add spike.py replay step 'replay_other_connector' (captured headers to /mcp/<other tenant>) and the aud mutation; optionally validly-signed max-TTL and sub-outside-tenant cases in the mutation script; state covered checks in M4.json DoD-4.

findings.problem: Says a cross-team call is refused on /mcp as isolation evidence, but on /mcp own-team calls of all 4 agents are refused too ('Access denied', RBAC tools.execute) in variant-c.observations.jsonl.
findings.required_improvement: Keep /rpc and /servers/{id}/mcp; state that global /mcp refuses team-scoped agent tokens for every tool on v1.1.1.

findings.problem: 'All paths' omits paths that skip tool_pre_invoke: direct_proxy gateways (MCPGATEWAY_DIRECT_PROXY_ENABLED, invoke_tool_direct bypasses plugins), resources/read, prompts/get. Fail closed at the connector, but undocumented.
findings.required_improvement: ADR and SEC-03: MCPGATEWAY_DIRECT_PROXY_ENABLED=false; identity-dependent data exposed only as tools (or hook resource/prompt pre-hooks).

findings.problem: Passthrough-misconfig stage cannot deliver any agent header on this MCP path in v1.1.1 (critic: allowlist loaded, gateway override null, X-Tenant-Id still not forwarded), so it proves nothing; ADR still says forged X-GxG-Identity was 'перезаписан'.
findings.required_improvement: Delete the stage, overlay and its evidence (or replace with a check of the plugin header filter); ADR: 'not reachable on v1.1.1; the signature is the guard'.

findings.problem: Verdict 'GO … (preliminary)' while roadmap condition 4 is not_run and 3 is partial; GO requires all 4.
findings.required_improvement: Reword to 'no NO-GO trigger found: 1, 2 confirmed; 3 partial; 4 not run (M5); decision at end of stage B'.

findings.problem: 'Key held only by the adapter': the adapter is the ContextForge process; any code execution there reads the key and mints JWS for every tenant.
findings.required_improvement: State the trust boundary in C 'Минусы'; production: secret store, kid rotation, alert on unknown kid. Backlog.

findings.problem: Principal = email local part (ContextForge exposes no user UUID). Deleting and recreating hermes@t-alpha gives a new agent the same principal and its grants.
findings.required_improvement: Runbook/GR note: agent emails never reused (or registry tombstones). Backlog.

findings.problem: Still says the 1.1.1 tag in .env.example is only a candidate; contradicts the pinned digest (executor flagged it).

5. ADR/SEC-03: direct_proxy must stay disabled; resources/prompts are not covered by tool_pre_invoke.

8. Re-run run_spike.sh, commit the new evidence and M4.json for the new commit.

comparison_m4_live.agreement: Same A mechanism (HMAC over user_id:email, one static signature per user, tenant unsigned, symmetric secret); A rejected; criteria 2 and 3 failed in both; tenant visibility per team on /rpc and virtual server; /mcp refused by RBAC for team tokens; advisories: none affect v1.1.1.
discrepancies: A criterion 1: executor failed (unsigned teams/admin, admin reaches tenant tool), m4-live passed for the path through ContextForge and counts the unsigned tenant under 2. A difference in how cases are counted, not in the facts; the decision is the same.
A criterion 5: executor passed as an upgrade rehearsal, m4-live not run.
m4-live calls the index digest 16c7a898… 'the linux/arm64 image'; registry returns it as the OCI index digest (multi-arch), so the pin is right and the m4-live note is inaccurate.
m4-live did not test variant C; its open items (direct_proxy, resources/prompts, multi-worker) are carried into findings 2 and 5.
